model.context: Tron 2026-05-30 (verbatim): "uuid identified instances are units in a data directory in scenario/index in which has folders from the first 5 characters of the uuid and there stores the original uuid.scenario.json. under scenarios/sprints.json/ create a file tree of ln links to the json index with speaking names like in sprint 1 and task1 and task 1.1. in scenarios/sprints.md/ have the resulting structured md views from the templates with the same speaking names as in the sprints.json/ folder."
